selection.score: mean marginal CI weight over batches containing the string
selection.candidate: sorted top-twelve alpha and beta Cartesian product

comparison.target: marginal-selection pilot elapsed time per pool
comparison.standard_stopping: complete Standard SQD restarts until target is met or exceeded
comparison.reference: exact sampled-product principal submatrix per pool
comparison.success: paired 95 percent CI for Standard minus marginal error is strictly positive and marginal measured solver time is no greater

limitations: Practical solver call-history independence is not separately established.
Success is relative to Standard SQD, not ZenKO.
